_about: A. E. Housman. Bloom's Western Canon (1994) lists: Collected Poems. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 under Adam's Bloom-only ruling; each row is US public domain (title page, Gutenberg header or IA metadata read, recorded in _bloom).

housman-shropshire-lad.case: Bloom lists Housman's Collected Poems. Its PD core is A Shropshire Lad (1896) and Last Poems (1922), both on PG.
housman-shropshire-lad.note: More Poems (1936) and the additional poems of the 1939 Collected Poems are NOT PD.
